items.claim: Ian Garry has evolved and does not fight the same way as he did in his earlier fights.
items.quote: And he does not fight the same. The biggest thing I'm impressed about Ian Garry is his evolution.

items.claim: Ian Garry traveled to the Republic of Georgia to train and focus on grappling.
items.quote: No, what No, he went out there to the freaking Republic of Georgia stand or whatever it's called and he's out there grappling, dude.
